paint.viewer.ui.layout

Class ViewerLayoutBuilder.LayoutComponents

  • java.lang.Object
    • paint.viewer.ui.layout.ViewerLayoutBuilder.LayoutComponents
  • Enclosing class:
    ViewerLayoutBuilder

    public static class ViewerLayoutBuilder.LayoutComponents
extends Object
    Holds all top-level Swing components created by the layout builder. ViewerFrame uses this object to update the UI during navigation.
